title: Managed Database: retention statement reconciliation — linked protection price-band reference
content:
## Assessment basis
Managed Database retention statement reconciliation uses the reference protected source volume in GB that defines the selected Managed Backup tier's price band. Use that price-band reference from the single active Managed Backup contract for the same customer and billing entity, or zero when none exists; multiple matches require selecting the contract named in the signed authorization before processing.

## Quantity identity
For retention statement reconciliation, the input is the selected Backup tier's protected-volume price-band reference in GB.

## Hypothetical selection case
Hypothetical retention statement reconciliation case: the selected active Backup contract and its tier remain unchanged while the measured retained quantity changes. The selected price-band reference remains unchanged.
